sentences.en: We have two movies, Obsession and Backrooms, that are such runaway successes that they basically shocked the industry.
sentences.zh: 我们有两部电影，《痴迷》和《后室》，它们获得了巨大的成功，基本上震惊了整个行业。

sentences.en: They were made for almost no money by young people who got their start on YouTube way, way, way outside the Hollywood studio system.
sentences.zh: 它们几乎没花什么钱，是由那些从YouTube起步、远远远离好莱坞制片厂体系的年轻人制作的。

sentences.en: And now here they are, beating Hollywood at their own game.
sentences.zh: 而现在，它们在这里击败了擅长这套的好莱坞。

sentences.en: And when we say runaway hits, what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 当我们说大获成功时，你指的是什么？

sentences.en: What I mean by that is you have the film Obsession, which is defying gravity of the box office from week to week in ways that have never been done before.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，比如《痴迷》这部电影，它在票房上打破常规，一周接一周地违背地心引力，这种现象前所未有。

sentences.en: And then you also have Backrooms, which became the highest grossing movie ever released by the studio A24 in the space of just 10 days.
sentences.zh: 还有《后室》，它在仅仅10天内就成为了A24电影公司发行的历史上票房最高的电影。

sentences.en: This is the studio that released films like Everything Everywhere All at Once and Marty Supreme, and Backrooms lapped them like it was nothing.
sentences.zh: 这家公司曾发行过《瞬息全宇宙》和《至尊马蒂》这样的电影，而《后室》超越它们简直轻而易举。

sentences.en: But it's not just that these films are making money.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅是因为这些电影在赚钱。

sentences.en: It's also who's going to see them.
sentences.zh: 还在于究竟是谁在去看它们。

sentences.en: These are huge, huge hits with Gen Z.
sentences.zh: 这些都是在Z世代中超级、超级火爆的大热作品。

sentences.en: And talking to people in Hollywood, executives, producers, directors, all sorts of people over the last several years, the number one anxiety I keep hearing is,

sentences.en: how do we get young people to care about the movies?

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: And for years now, it's become almost a cliche, I think, to hear that movie going is dead, that young people just don't go to the theaters.
sentences.zh: 多年来，听到电影业已死、年轻人根本不进电影院这种说法，我想这几乎已经成了一种陈词滥调。

sentences.en: This seems to disprove that.
sentences.zh: 这似乎推翻了那种说法。

sentences.en: It absolutely does.
sentences.zh: 完全推翻了。

sentences.en: And, you know, these films are on track to make hundreds of millions of dollars, like, to put that into perspective.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这些电影有望赚取数亿美元，打个比方来说，

sentences.en: This is all happening at the same time as the first Star Wars film in seven years,

sentences.en: And these two movies are making basically the exact same amount of money.
sentences.zh: 而这两部电影的票房收入基本上完全一样。

sentences.en: They cost virtually nothing compared to Star Wars, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，跟《星战》相比，它们的制作成本几乎为零。

sentences.en: And I think what they're proving is, young audiences don't want their parents' franchise hand-me-downs.
sentences.zh: 我想它们证明了，年轻观众并不想要他们父母那辈留下的老牌特许经营遗产。

sentences.en: They want a sense of investment in these movies.

sentences.en: And if you can make it feel like an event to them, they absolutely will go.

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: And I'm telling you that to put its massive success into some perspective, because at this point, after this last weekend, it just crossed $265 million at the global box office,

sentences.en: Without spoiling the movie, which I don't like horror movies generally, but I found it both terrifying and extremely compelling, what has made Gen Z come out in these numbers?
sentences.zh: 在不剧透的前提下——虽然我通常不喜欢恐怖片，但我发现这部电影既可怕又极具吸引力——究竟是什么让Z世代以这样的规模倾巢而出？

sentences.zh: 这就是好莱坞所有人都在问的重大问题。

sentences.en: Why?

sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为这部电影作为恐怖片很有效，尽管它的确如此。

sentences.en: I think a lot of it has to do with the fact that it is grappling with, you know, Gen Z more as the things that this younger generation is obsessed with,

sentences.en: That's all just underneath the surface.

sentences.en: And it means that you can go see this film with your friends, or talk about it with them on social media, and people are going to have different interpretations.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: It plays on this idea that dating and relationships and sex can be scary, you know, anxiety-provoking at a very deep level.

sentences.zh: 给我科普一下这个词吧，凯尔。

sentences.zh: 这是由动画电影《魔法满屋》发明的一个词，说来也奇怪。

sentences.en: And it refers to that point where you're so far into the discourse of a movie that people can't stop talking about,
sentences.zh: 这指的是这样一种程度：你对一部电影的讨论已经深入到了人们无法停止谈论的地步，

sentences.en: that basically no detail becomes too small for the internet to dig into.
sentences.zh: 以至于互联网对任何细节都会进行地毯式挖掘，觉得没有哪个细节是微不足道的。

sentences.en: And they call it corn plating because there was this meme of somebody posting the image of a secondary character from Encanto and saying,
sentences.zh: 他们把这称为“玉米盘事件”，因为当时有个网络迷因，有人发了一张《魔法满屋》里一个次要角色的剧照，并说：

sentences.en: I never realized that she was holding a plate of corn in this scene.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没注意到她在这一幕里端着一盘玉米。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's when you know you're really desperate for more details to dig into when you're getting down to that plate of corn.
sentences.zh: 这就说明你对挖掘更多细节有多渴望了，连那一盘玉米都不放过。

sentences.en: And you're saying this happened in this case with this movie?
sentences.zh: 你是说这部电影也出现了这种情况？

sentences.en: How did people, is it a verb, corn plate this movie?
sentences.zh: 人们是怎么做的？这难道是个动词吗，把这部电影“玉米盘”了？

sentences.en: Oh yeah, we're definitely now weeks into release.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，电影上映已经好几个星期了。

sentences.en: We're at the corn plating stage.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于“玉米盘”阶段。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Bear killed his cat in hopes to gain sympathy from Nicky because he is a covert narcissiSt.
sentences.zh: 贝尔为了博取尼基的同情而弄死了她的猫，因为他是个隐蔽型自恋狂。

sentences.en: Let me explain.
sentences.zh: 听我解释。

sentences.en: There are people who are suggesting that maybe our lead character is possessed by the spirit of his dead cat.
sentences.zh: 有人猜测，我们的男主角可能被他死去的猫的灵魂附身了。

sentences.en: So I don't think something jumps into Nicky's body.
sentences.zh: 所以我不觉得有什么东西钻进了尼基的身体。

sentences.en: I think she's split into two.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她分裂成了两个人。

sentences.en: There are people that are analyzing the strange possessed movements of our female lead.
sentences.zh: 有人在分析我们女主角那些奇怪的、仿佛被附身般的动作。

sentences.en: And immediately as a writer, I was like, no, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 作为一名编剧，我当时的第一反应就是：不，绝对不是这样的。

sentences.en: Like they are technically not the same thing.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，它们根本不是一回事。

sentences.en: They are not the same genre because romance as a genre.
sentences.zh: 它们的类型都不一样，因为浪漫爱情片作为一种类型……

sentences.en: They're really going deep on the themes and motifs of the movie.
sentences.zh: 他们真的在深入探讨这部电影的主题和母题。

sentences.en: Like it's hour three of a creative writing class and the students are getting punchy.
sentences.zh: 就像创意写作课上了整整三小时，学生们都开始进入亢奋状态了一样。

sentences.en: And even though some of these might strike you as reaches, I think they're emblematic of a discussion that people love to have on social media.
sentences.zh: 尽管其中有些解读在你看来可能有些牵强，但我认为它们正是人们热衷于在社交媒体上展开讨论的典型代表。

sentences.en: They want to dig into the lore of a movie.
sentences.zh: 他们想要深挖一部电影的背景设定和传说。

sentences.en: And if they can put forth a compelling enough through line in a YouTube video, they themselves might be able to draft off the success of the film.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能在油管视频中提出一条足够引人入胜的主线，他们自己说不定也能借着这部电影的成功顺势而起。

sentences.en: So basically what you're saying is that the themes in this movie and the way that it was consumed created so much discourse around the film itself
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才的意思是，这部电影的主题以及观众消费它的方式，围绕电影本身引发了如此热烈的讨论，

sentences.en: that it immediately generated this very particular Gen Z cultural moment and therefore drove ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 以至于它直接催生了非常独特的Z世代文化现象，进而拉动了票房？

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And this is a Gen Z cultural moment at the box office, the likes of which we've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 这是票房上从未见过的属于Z世代的文化盛景。

sentences.en: And you could be forgiven for thinking we might not see it again because it's so unique.
sentences.zh: 你甚至会觉得以后可能再也见不到这种场面了，因为它太独特了。

sentences.en: And yet, two weeks later, lightning struck again.
sentences.zh: 然而，两周之后，奇迹再次上演。

sentences.en: Another Gen Z movie defied box office records.
sentences.zh: 又一部Z世代的电影打破了票房纪录。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块的字谜游戏Connections。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作拼字游戏Spelling Bee和Letterboxd。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: Okay, Kyle.
sentences.zh: 好的，凯尔。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the second Gen Z hit, BackrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊第二部Z世代的票房爆款《后室》。

sentences.en: I also saw it, and it also scared me a lot.
sentences.zh: 我也看了，而且我也被吓得不轻。

sentences.en: What do we need to know about it?
sentences.zh: 我们关于它需要了解些什么？

sentences.en: Obsession might have crept up on the box office, but Backrooms took off like a rocket.
sentences.zh: 《Obsession》可能是悄悄逼近票房榜，但《后室》可以说是火箭般蹿升。

sentences.en: It made $80 million its first weekend.
sentences.zh: 它上映首周末就狂揽8000万美元票房。

sentences.en: And again, it's huge with young people.
sentences.zh: 而且同样地，它在年轻人中非常火爆。

sentences.en: Look, virtually the entire opening weekend audience was under 35.
sentences.zh: 你看，几乎整个首周末的观众群体都在35岁以下。

sentences.en: I found something.
sentences.zh: 我发现了点东西。

sentences.en: It's another horror movie, and it's about people who get trapped in this sort of liminal space universe.
sentences.zh: 这是另一部恐怖片，讲的是人们被困在某种临界空间宇宙里的故事。

sentences.en: I found a place.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一个地方。

sentences.en: These hallways that go on forever and are governed by some sort of unknowable dream logic.
sentences.zh: 这些走廊无休无止地延伸着，受制于某种不可名状的梦境逻辑。

sentences.en: I've been there every night since I found the place, and I still barely scratched the surface.
sentences.zh: 自从找到这个地方以来，我每天晚上都去，但依然只触及了皮毛。

sentences.en: I just take a slump.
sentences.zh: 我只是在猛冲。

sentences.en: You'll see strange things, sometimes strange figures, but also just kind of like sickly, yellow wallpaper vibes.
sentences.zh: 你会看到奇怪的东西，有时是奇怪的人影，但也只是一种病态的、黄色的墙纸氛围。

sentences.en: It has this feeling of walking to the break room in a terrible job and never, ever getting there.
sentences.zh: 它带有一种感觉：就像去一家糟糕公司里的员工休息室，却永远永远也走不到尽头。

sentences.en: Put me up!
sentences.zh: 扶我起来！

sentences.en: Put me up!
sentences.zh: 扶我起来！

sentences.en: Put me up!
sentences.zh: 扶我起来！

sentences.en: What do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: And it makes sense that it's connecting with young people because it was made by one.
sentences.zh: 它能和年轻人产生共鸣是合情合理的，因为它就是由年轻人制作的。

sentences.en: It was made by a 20-year-old director.
sentences.zh: 它出自一位20岁的新锐导演之手。

sentences.en: 20 years old is just bananas.
sentences.zh: 20岁简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So young.
sentences.zh: 太年轻了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The youngest director by far to ever top the box office, and the craziest part is he was actually only 17 when he was signed by A24 to make this movie.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他是登上票房榜首最年轻的导演，而最疯狂的是，当他被A24签约来制作这部电影时，其实才17岁。

sentences.en: It's just hard to actually believe.
sentences.zh: 这简直让人难以置信。

sentences.en: You spent a lot of time with him.
sentences.zh: 你花了很多时间跟他相处。

sentences.en: Kyle, just tell us his story.
sentences.zh: 凯尔，跟我们讲讲他的故事吧。

sentences.en: Much as I'd actually like to sit down, this wee menu music I think is going to interfere with the recording, so maybe we find a different purge or walk a little bit.
sentences.zh: 虽然我很想坐下来，但我觉得这首菜单背景音乐会干扰录音，所以我们或许该换个地方，或者稍微走走。

sentences.en: I like walking.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢走路。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, his name is Kane Parsons, and of course before I met him, I wondered who could this guy possibly be?
sentences.zh: 对，他叫凯恩·帕森斯。当然，在见到他之前，我在想这究竟会是个什么样的人？

sentences.en: You know, you might imagine some young cinephile who's eager to get into the Criterion closet and give you his letterbox top four.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可能会想象一个年轻的影迷，急着钻进标准收藏的柜子里向你展示他的Letterboxd最爱四部片。

sentences.en: And what I found is someone quite different from that.
sentences.zh: 但我发现他跟那完全是另一个人。

sentences.en: I would love to work in games, like, at some point.
sentences.zh: 我以后很想从事游戏行业。

sentences.en: I don't know when, like, it's probably not right.
sentences.zh: 我不知道什么时候，可能现在还不是时候。

sentences.en: This is somebody who, honestly, as he'll tell you, didn't watch a lot of films growing up.
sentences.zh: 这是一个老实说如他自己所说，在成长过程中并没有看过很多电影的人。

sentences.en: His approach is much more motivated by video games like Portal and Half-Life.
sentences.zh: 他的创作方法更多受到像《传送门》和《半条命》这样的电子游戏的启发。

sentences.en: The point is, Parsons does not have the resume of your typical filmmaker.
sentences.zh: 关键是，帕森斯并没有典型电影人的履历。

sentences.en: No, he very much doesn't.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没有。

sentences.en: But I found him to be incredibly unpretentious, very thoughtful, very solid feeling.
sentences.zh: 但我发现他极其质朴真诚、非常有思想、感觉非常踏实稳重。

sentences.en: And I could absolutely see why people would be willing to follow this young man into battle.
sentences.zh: 我完全能理解为什么人们愿意追随这个年轻人去披荆斩棘。

sentences.en: In a lot of ways, he's self-taught.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他是自学成才的。

sentences.en: By 2020, I, you know, during the pandemic, during, like, online classes, I was able to, like, have my screens split and be just playing around.
sentences.zh: 到2020年，你知道的，在大流行期间，在上网课的时候，我能够把屏幕分屏，然后就在那儿瞎琢磨。

sentences.en: You know, he came up on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他是通过油管发迹的。

sentences.en: He was born four months after YouTube was invented.
sentences.zh: 他出生在油管诞生四个月之后。

sentences.en: I don't mean to scare you by saying that.
sentences.zh: 我这么说可不是为了吓唬你。

sentences.en: It scared me when I learned it.
sentences.zh: 我刚知道这事儿的时候也被吓到了。

sentences.en: But, you know, he taught himself how to do all of this.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，这一切都是他自学的。

sentences.en: His film school was essentially YouTube tutorials.
sentences.zh: 他的电影学院基本上就是油管教程。

sentences.en: His feedback from fellow students was more like comments on YouTube and comments on Discord.
sentences.zh: 他从同行同学那里得到的反馈，更像是油管评论区和Discord频道里的留言。

sentences.en: And you can quibble with whether that's an acceptable substitute for an actual film school, but you can't beat the free tuition.
sentences.zh: 你可以争论这到底算不算正规电影学院的合格替代品，但免费的学费你是绝对没法挑剔的。

sentences.en: And so I, you know, started trying to figure out how to do 3D and After Effects, and Blender wasn't quite on my radar at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我呢，就开始琢磨怎么搞3D和AE特效，当时Blender还没怎么进入我的视线。

sentences.en: So he taught himself how to use Blender, which is a free visual effects software.
sentences.zh: 于是他自学了Blender，这是一款免费的视觉特效软件。

sentences.en: And he made his original short, Backrooms, found footage, which ended up getting, I think it's now at 80 million views.
sentences.zh: 他制作了最初的短片《后室：采风录像》，现在点击量好像已经达到8000万了。

sentences.en: It sounds like this guy is just a total self-starter.
sentences.zh: 听起来这家伙完全是个极具内驱力的人。

sentences.en: I mean, he literally teaches himself on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他literally就是通过油管自学成才的。

sentences.en: Is that why the thing he makes goes so incredibly viral?
sentences.zh: 难道这就是他的作品能病毒式爆红的原因吗？

sentences.en: That's part of it.
sentences.zh: 这是部分原因。

sentences.en: But also, he was basing this web series on something that had already gone viral.
sentences.zh: 但同时，他这个网络剧集是基于一个已经病毒式传播的概念创作的。

sentences.en: It's called a creepypasta, basically a scary meme that the internet finds and builds upon, sort of like a collective creative writing project,
sentences.zh: 这被称为“克里皮帕斯塔”（怪谈），基本上就是互联网发现并不断丰富完善的恐怖网络迷因，有点像集体创意写作项目，

sentences.en: or maybe like the online version of telling spooky stories around a campfire.
sentences.zh: 或者说有点像围坐在营火旁讲恐怖故事的网络版。

sentences.en: There's an original Backrooms image that got posted on 4chan of this decrepit department store.
sentences.zh: 最初在4chan上发布了一张关于这个破败百货商店的后室原始图片。

sentences.en: It's got creepy yellow fluorescent lighting.
sentences.zh: 那里有着令人毛骨悚然的黄色荧光照明。

sentences.en: It feels run down in that kind of abandoned mall kind of way.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是被废弃的商场一样破败不堪。

sentences.en: And people would write sort of short stories that were based on this image, imagining what might be just down the hallway if there's something even more terrifying.
sentences.zh: 人们会根据这张图片写一些短篇故事，想象着如果走廊深处藏着更可怕的东西，那会是什么样。

sentences.en: So what Kane Parsons did is, he was inspired by the lore that had already been created, but he made his own offshoot.
sentences.zh: 所以凯恩·帕森斯所做的，是从已经成型的设定中汲取灵感，并创作出了他自己的衍生作品。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Is someone there?
sentences.zh: 有人吗？

sentences.en: Found footage of a guy being lost in the Backrooms, but what's really startling when you watch this is not just how, you know, smartly made it is.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人迷失在后室中的伪纪录片影像，但当你观看时真正令人震惊的，不仅是它制作得多么聪明巧妙，

sentences.en: It's the fact that it was made by one person that he did all of these special effects, that he made this location in this free software.
sentences.zh: 而是它由一个人独立完成，所有的特效都是他做的，这个场景也是他用这款免费软件搭建的。

sentences.en: These are special effects made by a teenager that outclass almost everything that we see on big screens these days.
sentences.zh: 这些是由一个青少年制作的特效，其水准几乎秒杀如今我们在大银幕上看到的一切。

sentences.en: So Parsons is adapting IP in a sense.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，帕森斯是在改编IP。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe not in the traditional sense, but this Backrooms story is something that Gen Z is already iterating on and engaging with.
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许不是传统意义上的改编，但这个后室的故事确实是Z世代已经在不断迭代和参与其中的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, and he continued to iterate on it long before he made this film.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且早在拍这部电影之前很久，他就一直在对其进行迭代更新。

sentences.en: He made a few dozen installments of his Backrooms series for YouTube that has recurring characters, an eerie corporation that gets involved.
sentences.zh: 他在油管上为自己的《后室》系列制作了几十集内容，里面有 recurring的角色，还有一个介入其中的诡异公司。

sentences.en: And what really impressed me and surprised me, to be honest, is that he was perfectly happy there.
sentences.zh: 老实说，真正让我印象深刻并感到惊讶的是，他当时对现状感到非常满意。

sentences.en: You know, this is somebody who came up on YouTube as his primary means of expression, but also the primary thing he would watch.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是个在油管上长大的人，油管不仅是他主要的表达方式，也是他主要观看的内容来源。

sentences.en: The idea of making a movie, you know, though he wasn't opposed to it, wasn't the be-all-end-all goal.
sentences.zh: 拍电影这个想法，虽然他并不排斥，但绝不是他终极追求的目标。

sentences.en: You know, as he told me, he got a perfectly adequate level of creative satisfaction and financial compensation from staying on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 正如他所告诉我的，留在油管上就能让他获得相当适度的创意满足感和经济回报。

sentences.en: So why did he decide to make this a future film then?
sentences.zh: 那他后来为什么决定把这拍成一部长片电影呢？

sentences.en: Well, at first he didn't want to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一开始他并不想拍。

sentences.en: He was extremely skeptical, even when he was getting all of these amazing offers within weeks of posting his first video, because he'd seen it before.
sentences.zh: 他极其怀疑，甚至在发布第一段视频后短短几周内接到所有这些诱人的邀约时也是如此，因为他以前见得多了。

sentences.en: I came to drive this.
sentences.zh: 我来是为了推动这个。

sentences.en: This is something that I cared about, like, supremely, of, like, you know, making sure that it doesn't get away from,
sentences.zh: 这是我极其在乎的事情，比如，你知道的，要确保它不会背离

sentences.en: you know, its origins.
sentences.zh: 它的初心。

sentences.en: And it doesn't become, like,
sentences.zh: 并且不会变得像……

sentences.en: American Horror Stories did a Backrooms episode.
sentences.zh: 《美国恐怖故事》就拍过一集后室。

sentences.en: Did they?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's everything that, like, it shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 对，而且它拍出了所有不该有的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It fundamentally fails.
sentences.zh: 它彻底失败了。

sentences.en: He had seen out-of-touch Hollywood producers take something that got big on the internet and, in the big-screen translation, lose everything about it
sentences.zh: 他见多了不接地气的制片人把互联网上火爆的东西拿来，在搬上大银幕的改编过程中，却丢掉了所有

sentences.en: that made it appealing to his generation.
sentences.zh: 能吸引他那一代人的魅力所在。

sentences.en: There needs to be a respect to the material that already exists and respect to the people online who are already there for the material and the understanding that it's,
sentences.zh: 必须对现有的素材保持敬意，对网上那些已经为这些素材而来的受众保持敬意，并且要理解它，

sentences.en: you know, there's an elevated aspect to it beyond just, like, turning it into a slasher haunted house, like, flick, which, you know...
sentences.zh: 你知道的，除了把它变成那种……类似砍杀类的鬼屋惊悚片之外，它还有着更高的追求……

sentences.en: So he really resisted for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的很长一段时间都在抗拒。

sentences.en: It took the right arrangement of people, including A24, which is probably the most youth-focused studio there is.
sentences.zh: 这需要天时地利人和的阵容，包括A24——这可能是最专注于年轻一代的电影公司。

sentences.en: But also, Kane had his own idea of how he wanted to approach this.
sentences.zh: 但同时，凯恩对如何着手创作有他自己的想法。

sentences.en: He didn't want this to be an adaptation or a remake.
sentences.zh: 他不想把这拍成一部改编电影或翻版重制。

sentences.en: He considers this to be a supersized installment of the series that he already had going on for years.
sentences.zh: 他认为这是他已经连载多年的系列视频的超大加长版。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what he's made.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他所做出来的成果。

sentences.en: And because of the success of it, I presume that we're going to see a lot more from this series going forward.
sentences.zh: 鉴于它的成功，我推测接下来我们会看到这个系列更多的作品。

sentences.en: And do you think that what has been so compelling about this movie is that a bunch of young people basically are excited to see something that they watched on YouTube
sentences.zh: 你觉得这部电影之所以如此引人入胜，是不是因为大批年轻人基本上都很兴奋能在大银幕上看到他们在油管上

sentences.en: for a really long time on the big screen?
sentences.zh: 看了很长时间的东西？

sentences.en: Is it just that?
sentences.zh: 就只是这样吗？

sentences.en: I think that's a large part of it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这占了很大一部分。

sentences.en: I think he speaks in a visual language that a lot of young people recognize from video games, especially first-person shooters.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他使用的是一种年轻人从电子游戏，特别是第一人称射击游戏中能看懂的视觉语言。

sentences.en: These really prolonged takes, that anxiety over what might be just around the corner of a very long hallway.
sentences.zh: 那些真正超长的长镜头，那种对长长走廊拐角处可能潜伏着什么的焦虑。

sentences.en: But also, there's a lot of other ways that you can parse this, if you allow me to corn plate a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，如果你允许我稍微胡扯一下，还有很多其他方式可以解读这一点。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: I think that there is, there's a creeping fear of, you know, AI simulating us in ways that don't actually resemble what the human mind produces.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道的，人们有一种日益增长的恐惧，即人工智能在以并不真正符合人类思维产物的方式模拟我们。

sentences.en: Parsons has been not shy about his perspective on AI during this press tour.
sentences.zh: 帕森斯在这次新闻巡回宣传中一直毫不掩饰他对人工智能的看法。

sentences.en: He said that if he could stop generative AI with the snap of his fingers, he would do so.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果他能打个响指就阻止生成式人工智能，他会这么做。

sentences.en: And you see that in the back rooms, where whatever this, you know, little pocket universe is doing, it just doesn't feel quite right.
sentences.zh: 你在《后室》里也能看到这一点，无论这个，你知道的，微型袖珍宇宙在做什么，它就是感觉有点不对劲。

sentences.en: It feels like somebody who's trying to get us and doing us wrong.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像有人正试图算计我们，对我们图谋不轨。

sentences.en: Just a step back, Kyle, what should we make of these two huge successes?
sentences.zh: 退一步说，凯尔，我们该如何看待这两个巨大的成功？

sentences.en: I could see the argument that, you know, maybe this is just a flash in the pan and we should not read too much into it, you know, from an industry perspective.
sentences.zh: 我能理解这种观点，你知道的，也许这只是昙花一现，从行业角度来看，我们不应该过度解读。

sentences.en: But is it indicative of some broader shift in the consumer behavior of Gen Z when it comes to the movies, when it comes to the theaters?
sentences.zh: 但这是否预示着 Z 世代在电影和影院方面的消费行为发生了某种更广泛的转变？

sentences.en: I think it absolutely is.
sentences.zh: 我认为绝对是的。

sentences.en: And it's undeniable, based on the strength of these two movies, it proves that young people do want to go to the movie theater.
sentences.zh: 这是不可否认的，基于这两部电影的强势表现，它证明了年轻人确实想去电影院。

sentences.en: You just have to give them a reason.
sentences.zh: 你只需要给他们一个理由。

sentences.en: You have to make it feel like an event.
sentences.zh: 你得让他们觉得这是一场活动。

sentences.en: It might not be an automatic thing like it was, you know, in previous generations.
sentences.zh: 它可能不像以前那样，你知道的，是老一代人那种顺理成章的事情。

sentences.en: Well, they'll just go on a Friday and decide what to see once they get to the theater.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们只是在周五去，到了电影院再决定看什么。

sentences.en: They want to go see specific movies, but they absolutely do want to go.
sentences.zh: 他们想去看特定的电影，但他们绝对是想去的。

sentences.en: And they'll go back once, twice, three times if you give them something that's worth discussing.
sentences.zh: 如果你给他们一些值得讨论的东西，他们会去看一遍、两遍、三遍。

sentences.en: Is the premise there underneath what you're saying that Hollywood hasn't been giving them a reason thus far?
sentences.zh: 你刚才这番话背后的前提是，好莱坞迄今为止一直没有给他们一个理由吗？

sentences.en: Hollywood's been giving them hand-me-downs, you know?
sentences.zh: 好莱坞一直在给他们穿旧衣服，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to wear all the clothes that, you know, your dad or mom or even grandparents gave you?
sentences.zh: 你想穿你爸爸妈妈甚至爷爷奶奶给你的所有衣服吗？

sentences.en: You know, Star Wars is a franchise that started in the 1970s, another film that we've got out right now,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，《星球大战》是一个始于 20 世纪 70 年代的系列，我们现在还有另一部上映的电影，

sentences.en: Masters of the Universe, which is underperforming.
sentences.zh: 《宇宙的getMaster》，这部表现不佳。

sentences.en: That's based on He-Man toys from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 那是基于 80 年代的希曼玩具。

sentences.en: If you didn't grow up with those properties, you might not understand the fervor with which an older generation would greet them.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有伴随着这些作品长大，你可能无法理解老一辈人迎接它们时的那种狂热。

sentences.en: And you're certainly not going to rush out to the theater to see them when you could go to Obsession or Backrooms again.
sentences.zh: 当你本来可以再次去看《执念》或《后室》时，你当然不会急冲冲地赶去电影院看这些。

sentences.en: Films made by your generation for your generation.
sentences.zh: 由你们这代人为你们这代人制作的电影。

sentences.en: So what is the lesson then for Hollywood from these two movies?
sentences.zh: 那么对于好莱坞来说，这两部电影带来的教训是什么？

sentences.en: If there is obviously a huge desire to replicate this success,
sentences.zh: 如果显然有巨大的渴望来复制这种成功，

sentences.en: what's the roadmap that this offers?
sentences.zh: 这提供了什么发展蓝图？

sentences.en: That's the million-dollar question.
sentences.zh: 这就是价值百万美元的问题。

sentences.en: And that is the question that everybody is asking each other.
sentences.zh: 这也是每个人都在互相询问的问题。

sentences.en: And they're asking me.
sentences.zh: 他们也在问我。

sentences.en: I was at the premiere of Toy Story 5 this past week, you know, a film based on massive IP, and it's going to be a big blockbuster.
sentences.zh: 我上周去参加了《玩具总动员 5》的首映礼，你知道的，一部基于庞大 IP 的电影，它将成为一部大片。

sentences.en: But at the same time, that's not what people wanted to talk about at the after party.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这并不是大家在庆功宴上想谈论的话题。

sentences.en: They wanted to talk about Obsession and BackrooMs.
sentences.zh: 他们想谈论的是《执念》和《后室》。

sentences.en: I was just also recently interviewing Emily Blunt, who stars in Steven Spielberg's new film,
sentences.zh: 我最近还采访了艾米莉·布朗特，她主演了史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的新片，

sentences.en: Disclosure Day.
sentences.zh: 《披露日》。

sentences.en: And the most animated she got during the whole interview is when we talked about Backrooms and Obsession and this cultural moment.
sentences.zh: 在整个采访过程中，她表现得最兴高采烈的时候，就是我们谈论《后室》和《执念》以及这个文化时刻的时候。

sentences.en: I think it is exciting to executives, to producers, to talent, to see that young people still want to carry on this tradition of going to see movies, especially when they have
sentences.zh: 我想，看到年轻人仍然想要延续看电影的传统，对于高管、制片人和演艺人员来说是令人兴奋的，特别是当他们有

sentences.en: so many options available to them.
sentences.zh: 这么多选择可供他们使用时。

sentences.en: They have TikTok.
sentences.zh: 他们有 TikTok。

sentences.en: They have streaming services.
sentences.zh: 他们有流媒体服务。

sentences.en: So if you can craft a compelling case, if you can say, this is worth experiencing with your fellow moviegoers, this is worth actually leaving your house to go do,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能给出一个引人入胜的理由，如果你能说，这值得与你的影迷同伴一起体验，这值得你真正离开家去做这件事，

sentences.en: I think young people want to.
sentences.zh: 我想年轻人是愿意的。

sentences.en: You know, both these films were made for under $10 million.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这两部电影的制作成本都在 1000 万美元以下。

sentences.en: Obsession was made for under $1 million.
sentences.zh: 《执念》的制作成本甚至不到 100 万美元。

sentences.en: So it doesn't cost a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以它不需要花很多钱。

sentences.en: And the dividends can be so great when you hit.
sentences.zh: 而当你一炮走红时，回报可以是如此丰厚。

sentences.en: So suddenly, somehow, the future of Hollywood looks brighter, kind of thanks to YouTube.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，不知何故，好莱坞的未来看起来更加光明了，某种程度上多亏了 YouTube。

sentences.en: And truly, who would have thought?
sentences.zh: 说实话，谁能想到呢？

sentences.en: But let me be clear, you know, this isn't the end of corporate IP.
sentences.zh: 但我要明确一点，你知道的，这并不是企业 IP 的终结。

sentences.en: This isn't the end of major film franchises.
sentences.zh: 这并不是主要电影系列的终结。

sentences.en: You've got a Spider-Man movie about to come out.
sentences.zh: 你有一部《蜘蛛侠》电影即将上映。

sentences.en: You've got Toy Story 5.
sentences.zh: 你有《玩具总动员 5》。

sentences.en: But still, at the same time, there's a moment happening that can't be ignored.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，与此同时，正在发生一个不容忽视的时刻。

sentences.en: It can't be swept under the rug.
sentences.zh: 它不能被掩盖过去。

sentences.en: Both Obsessions and Backrooms, they're these really sharp, provocative visions from young and talented filmmakers.
sentences.zh: 无论是《执念》还是《后室》，它们都是来自年轻且有才华的电影制作人非常犀利、具有挑衅性的愿景。

sentences.en: They definitely could not have been made by Hollywood's old guard.
sentences.zh: 它们绝对不可能是由好莱坞的老派人物制作出来的。

sentences.en: And I think that's the big lesson to draw from here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是这里需要吸取的巨大教训。

sentences.en: Because the enormous, staggering, record-breaking popularity of these movies suggests that this is something these audiences have been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 因为这些电影巨大、惊人、打破纪录的受欢迎程度表明，这是这些观众一直以来都在等待的东西。

sentences.en: Well, Kyle, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，凯尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me, Natalie, and I hope having to see these two movies didn't traumatize you too terribly.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，娜塔莉，我希望看这两部电影没有给你留下太可怕的心理创伤。

sentences.en: Not too bad.
sentences.zh: 还行，不算太糟。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: and Iran have signed a framework agreement ending their months-long war, but neither side published the deal's full text.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗签署了一项框架协议，结束了他们长达数月的战争，但双方都没有公布该协议的全文。

sentences.en: The immediate scope was focused on ending military attacks and allowing tankers to begin moving freely through the Strait of Hormuz,
sentences.zh: 当务之急是结束军事袭击，并允许油轮开始在霍尔木兹海峡自由通行，

sentences.en: which President Trump said could happen as soon as Friday.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，这最早可能在周五发生。

sentences.en: But even though Trump said the Strait would open without tolls,
sentences.zh: 但尽管特朗普表示海峡将在没有收费的情况下开放，

sentences.en: Iran said on Monday that it intended to charge fees for unspecified services rendered in the Strait.
sentences.zh: 伊朗周一表示，它打算对在海峡提供的未指明服务收取费用。

sentences.en: The net effect could add a new expense and complications for commercial ships that need to pass through the waterway.
sentences.zh: 最终的影响可能会给需要通过该水道的商船增加新的费用和复杂情况。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Donald Trump isn't just coming after me because of my mean tweets.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对我不仅仅是因为我在推特上刻薄。

sentences.en: He's coming after me because I'm considering running for president.
sentences.zh: 他针对我是因为我在考虑竞选总统。

sentences.en: In a video on Monday,
sentences.zh: 在周一的一段视频中，

sentences.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom said that federal agents had been questioning his and his wife's friends and associates, describing the inquiry as politically motivated.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州长加文·纽森表示，联邦特工一直在盘问他和妻子的朋友及熟人，他将这种调查描述为出于政治动机。

sentences.en: They're demanding records.
sentences.zh: 他们在索取记录。

sentences.en: They're abusing the grand jury process, digging through years and years of random documents.
sentences.zh: 他们在滥用大陪审团程序，翻找长年累月的各种随机文件。

sentences.en: The full scope of any investigation remains unclear, but Newsom's aides say that it appears to focus on his wife,
sentences.zh: 任何调查的具体范围仍不清楚，但纽森的助手表示，调查似乎集中在他的妻子身上，

sentences.en: Jennifer Seibel Newsom.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·西贝尔·纽森。

sentences.en: Someone who has done nothing wrong other than having the temerity to advocate for what she believes in.
sentences.zh: 她没有做错任何事，只是有勇气去倡导她所信仰的东西。

sentences.en: A person familiar with the matter told The Times that multiple federal investigations were underway related to the governor, including one looking at his wife's finances,
sentences.zh: 一位知情人士告诉《泰晤士报》，针对州长的多项联邦调查正在进行中，其中包括一项调查他妻子的财务状况，

sentences.zh: 但该人士表示，这些调查是由加州的联邦执法官员发起的，而不是由华盛顿的官员发起的。

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？
